goals: Verify the sanitization of the application's configuration object.
Verify that application routes are protected and require authentication.
activities: Load authentication configuration into global scope.
Verify the configuration object is defined.
Verify the client ID in the configuration does not match a GUID pattern.
Verify the tenant ID in the configuration does not match a GUID pattern.
Prepare to send an HTTP request to the application.
Send a GET request to the '/api' endpoint.
Verify the response status code is 401 (Unauthorized).
